subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep dive / demo
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellaranalytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellaranalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep dive / demo

Hi Alex and Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really enjoyed the conversation and learning more about Stellar Analytics' pipeline and latency targets. Per our call, the next best step is a technical deep dive where we can:

- Walk through your typical request profile and sequence lengths
- Discuss batching/caching options to hit your 99th percentile SLOs
- Show a short live demo of the Redwood runtime on a similar workload

Suggested slots (PDT):
- Thu 6/10, 9:30–10:15am
- Thu 6/10, 1:00–1:45pm
- Fri 6/11, 11:00–11:45am

If those don't work, happy to propose others — please indicate your preferred slot and who from your side will join. We'll plan for ~45 minutes and include one of our Solutions Engineers (Marissa) on the call.

Attached is a short discovery recap and a proposed agenda. Once we lock a time I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: RIF-Discovery-Recap.pdf (summary), RIF-Technical-Deep-Dive-Agenda.docx (proposed agenda)
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellaranalytics.com>

Thanks, Camila — this looks great.

We can do Thu 6/10 but the 9:30am slot conflicts with an internal sync. The 1:00pm slot should work for me and Priya. Marissa — can you join as the SE?

One quick ask: would you be able to include example token/throughput numbers for a 5k request/day baseline vs. 50k request/day burst in the agenda? That'll help our infra folks orient before the call.

Alex
Director of ML Engineering
